description: This file provides minimal implementations of functions that mimic Go 1.21's standard library features, aimed at supporting compatibility with older Go versions. It includes utility functions for slices, synchronization, comparison, and type constraints, specifically tailored for Linux builds excluding Go 1.21.

methods.name: clearSlice
methods.description: Clears the elements of a slice by setting each element to its zero value.

methods.name: slicesIndexFunc
methods.description: Returns the index of the first element in the slice that satisfies the predicate function.

methods.name: SlicesDeleteFunc
methods.description: Deletes elements from a slice based on a predicate function, returning the modified slice.

methods.name: SlicesContains
methods.description: Checks if a slice contains a specific value.

methods.name: SlicesClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a slice.

methods.name: SyncOnceValue
methods.description: Returns a function that executes a given function once, caching its result.

methods.name: SyncOnceValues
methods.description: Returns a function that executes a given function returning two values once, caching its results.

methods.name: isNaN
methods.description: Checks if a floating-point value is NaN without using the math package.

methods.name: CmpCompare
methods.description: Compares two ordered values, considering NaN cases.

methods.name: Max2
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two ordered values.
